decision: Model Offer generation (first and successor) requires modelApprovalDecisionId in every body, replays included; requireModelApprovalDecisionId and the replay binding's null branch go
why: Only receipts recorded before #1191 named no approval; nothing is deployed, so no current client sends a body without it (the web form and every fixture name it since #1330)

decision: Company model commands match a receipt by the raw-payload fingerprint only; the Contract kind's parsed-intent fallback (parsedIntentReceipts) goes
why: It kept receipts fingerprinted before #1191 replaying for in-flight retries across a deployment; there is no deployment before launch

decision: The API Contract reader requires the latest run to name the version's bound rule set (was: not above it); the web readRecordedContractQualityRun goes and the latest run, history and reopened runs use readContractQualityRun
why: A lower version was allowed only for v1 runs recorded before rule set v2 existed; the insert guard of 0064 binds every later run and the binding derives from the immutable Snapshot and template, so no current run can differ

decision: 0119 is a custom migration that refuses (RAISE) when contract_quality_runs holds a run whose rule_set_version differs from contract_version_quality_rule_set; it changes no schema
why: Runs are immutable (0054 trigger), so an earlier row cannot be rewritten; the check is the insert guard's own binding applied to stored rows

decision: 0119 does not check Offer or Company model receipts
why: offer_commands and the model command tables store only a SHA-256 fingerprint of the command, so a receipt fingerprinted under the earlier rule is indistinguishable in the database from a current one; it is read only by a retry under the same key, which now fails closed (400 for an Offer body without the approval, 409 for a model command) and writes nothing
evidence: offer_commands and offer_model_commands/contract_model_commands schemas; the two REST refusal tests

decision: The adjusted-Snapshot SQL seeds move unchanged from contract-adjusted-snapshot.migration.test.ts to contract-adjusted-snapshot.test-support.ts, shared with the 0119 proof
why: The 0119 proof needs real versions bound to v1 and v2, which those seeds already build under every current guard
